questions.prompt: Name a real cave or cave system.
questions.scope: Real named caves, cave systems, rock shelters and historical rock-cut cave complexes count, including show caves. An ordinary mine or tunnel does not automatically count; fictional caves are excluded.
questions.rationale: One independently chosen whole global feature category, never one question per country, altitude, letter or paired label. All primary source rows of eligible feature classes are reconciled. Common-name and source-eligibility checks supplement the gazetteer; real synonyms share scoring identity.
